newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel estimates boosted.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel estimates boosted.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said its analyst Robert Chaplinsky raised his earnings estimates for Intel Corp, citing excellent manufacturing performance, higher microprocessor volumes and and excellent gross margins.

-- Chaplinsky raised his Q4 earnings estimate to $1.86/shr on revenues of about $6.04 billion from $1.74/shr on revenues of $5.85 billion. His 1996 year estimate rose to $5.53/shr on revenes of $20.4 billion from $5.41 on revenues of $20.26 billion. He raised his full year 1997 estimate to $7.81 a share on revenues of $25.1 billion from $7.14 a share on revenues of $24.7 billion.
